 Add as a preferred source on Google The Nagaland state has declared the Dear Sambad lottery results that are scheduled on 1PM, 6PM and 8PM on November 13, 2026. The State's Friday result includes Dear Victory 1PM Morning result, Dear Crown Evening 6PM and Dear Horizon 8PM Night results. All three lotteries are offering Rs 1 crore as first prize. The cost of the lottery is Rs 6 per ticket.
